verdict.rationale: Apple documents that bringing a paired iPhone near a new Mac lets Setup Assistant automatically sign in to Wi-Fi and Apple Account (macos-docs-14), directly matching the story, and Migration Assistant support further eases new-machine setup for switchers (macos-docs-2). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the proximity-based setup flow and details on edge cases (e.g., non-Apple prior device, failure modes).
